narrativeProgression.description: Discussion about the opposition to Sunday hunting and the benefits of allowing it.
Harold Daub addresses the concern that Sunday hunting would limit other outdoor activities, sharing his personal experiences.
He questions why opponents desire a hunter-free day when they already enjoy activities during the week amidst hunting season.
He provides an anecdote about encountering mountain bikers and hikers, including one with a toddler, on the opening day of turkey season, emphasizing that these activities coexist with hunting.
He notes the declining hunting numbers in Pennsylvania while highlighting the enduring popularity of turkey hunting.
He cites statistics from the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources (DCNR) that show Saturday as the peak day for all outdoor activities, including hunting.
